lines: What is wrong with you? You bitch—!
You're not allowed to be this—stupid. Do you really think that—
(—cure, what cure? Nothing can cure the rot, it's eating me from inside my guts, my lungs, my intestines—)
You owe it to me. You love me. You can't just do this to me.
(—you can't leave me here—please, it's so dark, Maman—Maman ne me laisse pas içi seule je vais mourir maman—)
I wanted your head in that basket.
I knew you loved me too much to kill me—and I love you enough to kill you.
(Please—! Please just—say you're proud of me…)
